subject: MedixHealth DPA & SCC pathway — post-call recap and proposed MAP
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Byrne <sarah.byrne@medixhealth.com>, security@medixhealth.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: MedixHealth follow-up: DPA draft, SCC options & next steps (post-call)

Hi Sarah / Medix security team,

Thanks again for taking the call today — good to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of today’s discussion:
- MedixHealth is evaluating Redwood for chat/summary workflows that will process customer PII; potential limited PHI in specific care-coordinator flows.
- Primary concerns: (1) DPA terms (data residency + deletion windows), (2) SCC module selection for EU customers, and (3) SOC 2 / HIPAA posture.

What I’m attaching/including:
- Redwood-DPA-draft-20260218.pdf (attached): editable DPA with standard Redwood terms and two optional SCC modules (A: modular SCC + controller/processor mapping; B: vendor-only SCC).
- SCC-module-matrix-20260218.csv (attached): quick compare table we discussed.
- Security questionnaire link (DSQ): https://redwood.app/security-questionnaire/medixhealth/DSQ-98123

Open items / clarifying questions for Medix:
1) For EU customers, do you plan to act as controller for end-customer data or require Redwood to be controller for specific subservices? (We discussed controller = Medix for app-level data; want confirmation.)
2) Is HIPAA coverage required for the initial pilot? If yes, we can surface our BA agreement path and front-load SOC/HIPAA artifacts.
3) Preferred SCC module: please indicate A or B from the attached matrix.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- By Fri 2/20: Medix to indicate SCC module choice and confirm controller/processor mapping and HIPAA requirement (if any).
- By Mon 2/23: Redwood to provide redlines on DPA and upload SOC 2 summary + latest security snapshot to the DSQ portal.
- By Wed 3/03: Target DocuSign for DPA execution (if terms are agreed).

If this looks right I’ll open a HubSpot MAP and post the DocuSign placeholder. Also looping Rishi and Monica here to handle legal redlines and procurement questions.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0122

--
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Byrne <sarah.byrne@medixhealth.com>

Cc: security@medixhealth.com, procurement@medixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedixHealth follow-up: DPA draft, SCC options & next steps (post-call)

Thanks Evelyn — nice to meet you on the call. A few quick clarifications from legal: 

1) Controller/Processor: MedixHealth will be controller for customer account data. For the limited PHI scenarios (care-coordinator flows), Medix will still be controller and Redwood will act as processor. If there are any features where Redwood independently enriches or derives data for its own product analytics we need explicit carve-outs in the DPA.

2) SCC module: we prefer the modular SCC approach (your Module A) so we can adopt EU modules selectively. Please flag which modules cover subprocessing / onward transfer clauses.

3) HIPAA: Pilot does not require HIPAA right away. We may open a HIPAA path if pilot expands to clinical notes in Q3. Please ensure the DPA identifies a route to a BA agreement in the future.

Action items from our side:
- We’ll mark Module A as preferred and confirm internally by EOD Fri 2/20.
- Security team will start the DSQ intake this afternoon and notify you if they need live artifacts (SOC 2 report, pen test results).
- Procurement will need expected commercial timeline — could you confirm when DPA + SCC are expected to be fully executed, assuming fast turn?

Sarah Byrne
Associate General Counsel, MedixHealth
sarah.byrne@medixhealth.com

Eve — two internal notes after reviewing Sarah’s reply and the attachments: 

1) DPA / controller carve-outs: Add explicit language that Redwood will not act as controller on customer data unless separately contracted (we should add a one-line exclusion under Section 2.1).
2) SCC module matrix: Module A is fine but flag Module A.3 (onward transfer) — we need to ensure it references our subprocessors list URL rather than a static list. That eases updates.
3) SOC 2: we should push the SOC 2 Type II summary now and a redacted Report on Controls to the DSQ portal. Monica, can you queue those artifacts to the intake?

Procurement timing: if Medix indicates Module A by EOD, we can provide redlines and a DocuSign-ready file by Mon 2/23. If procurement needs a PO/contract signature before DocuSign we’ll coordinate.

TL;DR: Follow Sarah’s ask, confirm Module A, prepare SOC 2 artifact upload, and add controller exclusion language.

-rishi
VP, Contracts & Compliance (on behalf of Legal Ops)
